authored_from: run_2's raw per-category results, converted back to whole counts. No run_3 result existed when this file was written, and none may be consulted to change it.

denominators.note: 183 + 20 = 203. The ranking denominator is 183 — not 203, which would fold the hard negatives into a ranking average, and not 143, which is the figure the earlier final report reached by dropping the 지역+직함(문장) category from its own sum.

reported_not_gated.why_metrics: run_2 preserved MRR and nDCG@5 only rounded to four decimals, so any threshold taken from them would be a threshold on rounding rather than on retrieval. They are recorded every run and compared by hand.
reported_not_gated.why_categories: the concept categories are measured with no embedding model. Their numbers describe keyword search attempting questions built to need meaning, so freezing them as a bar would freeze the absence of the model.

run_2_derivation.method: per-category rate × n, rounded to the nearest whole card
run_2_derivation.cross_check: 154 / 183 = 0.841530, which reproduces run_2's reported overall P@1 of 0.8415
run_2_derivation.status_of_the_source: run_2 is INVALID AS PASS for its abstention claim and DIAGNOSTIC ONLY for its ranking figures. Its ranking numbers are used here only as a non-regression floor, which is a use its own defect does not touch: the excluded query had an empty relevant set and contributed to no ranking numerator or denominator.

abstention_contract.requirement: all twenty hard negatives return an empty result
abstention_contract.note: run_1 failed this at 19/20 and run_2 removed the failing query from the requirement. The population here is the whole twenty and the runner has no mechanism for removing one.
